note: Literature confirms peripheral axonal neuropathy presenting with motor features (wrist/foot drop) is a rare/expanded phenotype in NKX6-2/SPAX8 cases.

evidence.text: Two affected siblings with an NKX6-2 missense variant presented with wrist and foot drop attributed to peripheral axonal neuropathy, reported as a novel phenotypic expansion.

source.title: Expanding the clinical and neuroimaging features of NKX6-2-related hereditary spastic ataxia type 8
source.quote: wrist and foot drop due to peripheral axonal neuropathy were observed in these patients as a new clinical finding
